description: Create a new workspace (with its sandbox), owned by the person who created your key, on the free plan. Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the workspace:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused. Where workspace administration by key is not released for your workspace the call is refused with 403. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Made from the name when left out.

name: create_workspace
